_doc: DESCRIPTIVE regime re-slice of already-computed graveyard per-trade records. No new replays, no new variants, no re-optimization. See module docstring.

axis_excluded.premarket_range_pct: No repo-wide historical premarket high/low dataset spans the full 2025-01-02..2026-07-27 replay window; only current-day snapshots exist (eod-deep-*.json, swarm state). Ad hoc derivation from raw 5m bars risks the documented DST/frame look-ahead bug (CLAUDE.md C6). Excluded per pre-reg's own sanctioned fallback rather than fabricated.

requires: BH-significant at q<=0.10 across the full slice surface

significance_test: One-sample one-sided t-test (scipy.stats.ttest_1samp) on per-trade dollar_pnl, H1: mean>0. Requires n>=2 and non-degenerate variance; slices failing that precondition get p_one_sided_gt0=null and are excluded from the BH surface (they also fail n>=25 by construction in every such case here).

provenance.note: Other sensitivity cells (SENSITIVITY_lane7_subset, SENSITIVITY_lane8_subset, INTERMED_lane9_confluence_anyHTF, INTERMED_lane9_htfBEAR_anyTrigger) only have aggregate stats persisted, no per-trade array -- excluded per pre-reg's 'if per-trade detail was not persisted, exclude and say so' rule. Only the named graveyard variant (score>=9 + confluence + htf) has per-trade detail.
